title: Candy Golem
html:
Candy Golems are large, disembodied candy heads. Usually one is found in connection with a horde of Abba Labbas in the Storerooms off of The Embercore Path. They have strong knockback powers and regenerate hit points. Abba Labba wizards can summon them, and they will disappear after the wizard is destroyed. They drop lots of candy.

Note: as of build 147, they no longer appear to drop candy.

Race:Golem

Class:Melee Fighter
